raw.note: Phase F estimand: ontology-predicate assertions, soft-object match, no validation/scoping

clean.note: validated + in-unit + canonical-matched; gate applies here

clean_unfiltered.note: DIAGNOSTIC, NOT GATED. CLEAN minus the object-type contract filter. The gap between this and `clean` is the object_type_* reject mass — see reject_reasons. Reported so the choice of gated estimand is an argued number: moving the gate here would restate every figure in the h5 trail and is a campaign, not a patch.

ruler.note: Every input the ratios above are a function of. `pinned` digests are enforced: a run whose live ruler differs FAILS CLOSED and quotes no ratio. `triples` is recorded and never pinned — it is the thing under measurement, so a graph-only change still scores at full sensitivity. Quote clean_n, raw_n, entity rows, triple rows, id_map entries, judge_unavailable and fixture_docs_matched with every coverage number; a ratio without them is not comparable to any other run.

triples.note: the graph under measurement — recorded, never pinned

fixture_sample.note: Fixture/sample alignment. A sampled document the fixture does not cover scores 0/0 and disappears while n_docs_sampled and judge_unavailable still read clean, so any miss is FAIL: re-pin the fixture or narrow with --editions. Unused fixture entries are reported, not fatal — a deliberately smaller --sample-n is legitimate.
